mapper.select: select count(*) from vpn_local_user where del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from line_app where status = '0'

select date(access_time) as stat_date, sum(case when status = '0' and msg like '[connect]%' then 1 else 0 end) as connect_success, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as login_fail from vpn_logininfor where access_time >= #{beginTime} group by date(access_time) order by stat_date asc
select client_os as name, count(*) as value from vpn_logininfor where access_time >= #{beginTime} and client_os is not null and client_os != '' group by client_os order by value desc limit #{limit}
select msg as name, count(*) as value from vpn_logininfor where status = '1' and access_time >= #{beginTime} group by msg order by value desc limit #{limit}
select info_id, user_name, login_purpose, app_id, app_name, ipaddr, client_os, client_mac, status, msg, access_time from vpn_logininfor order by info_id desc limit #{limit}
